title: AI-Generated Images of [person] with [person] Spread as Disinformation Before U.S. Primary Elections

behaviors.text: In the run-up to the U.S.
primary elections, supporters of [person] shared AI-generated images showing him with [person] in an attempt to sway African-American votes.

These deepfakes, including [person]'s distorted hand visuals, were initially created by satirical accounts but were later misappropriated for political disinformation, misleading millions on social media platforms.
